en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Al Husayn Bin Maysay who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Garden of Adam<sup>as</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It was a garden from the gardens of the world, wherein the sun emerged, and the moon, and had it been from the Gardens of the Paradise, he<sup>as</sup> would not have come out from it, ever!’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr from al-Husayn ibn Muyassir who has said the following: “

I asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the garden of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. He said, ‘It was a garden of the gardens of the world on which the sun and moon rise. Had it been of the gardens of the hereafter, he would have never been expelled there from.’”
